summary: Executed all 6 phases of the plan across 3 waves. Wave 1 (phases 1-4, parallel territory): repaired the install-extension.sh symlink-deploy regression (fixed the hardcoded rel_path at all 5 sites in both byte-identical copies, deleted and recreated the 19 broken cslib/literature/pr-review symlinks, deleted 2 dead zotero symlinks); backfilled the 4 core-owned orphans (no-task-references-in-deliverables.md, commands/README.md with rewritten content, lint-contract-compliance.sh, validate-handoff.sh); backfilled the 8 literature-owned orphans (6 scripts + 2 context patterns) and resolved literature-organization.md ownership to literature's own context/guides/ tree; backfilled the nvim orphan (extension-deploy-modes.md, content extended) plus 4 more core context/patterns+guides orphans, and resolved the fork-patterns.md duplicate (byte-identical to existing core docs/fork-patterns.md -- deleted the deployed copy and its stale index.json entry). Wave 2 (phase 5): added 5 new project-wide checks to check-extension-docs.sh (Rules J/K/L/M for per-category orphans, Rule N for broken deployed symlinks), landed byte-identical in both copies, gated by a single ORPHAN_GATE_MODE toggle defaulting to advisory; verified 0 orphans and 0 broken symlinks on the remediated tree via scratchpad-only destructive testing. Wave 3 (phase 6): flipped ORPHAN_GATE_MODE's default to hard, added a Rule A-N header index, confirmed exit 0 on the real tree and non-zero exit with a git-tracked-then-reverted throwaway orphan, added minimal CI wiring (.github/workflows/check-extension-docs.yml, none existed before), and wrote the implementation summary. Task status transitioned planned -> implementing -> completed.

decisions_made: literature-organization.md: moved to literature's own context/guides/ tree, declared a new "guides" context entry on literature (alongside core's pre-existing, non-colliding "guides" entry) -- per research recommendation (a).

fork-patterns.md: confirmed byte-identical to agent-system/extensions/core/docs/fork-patterns.md via diff; treated docs/fork-patterns.md as canonical, deleted the deployed context/patterns/ copy and its now-dangling context/index.json metadata entry, no new source created.

ORPHAN_GATE_MODE single-toggle design: all 5 new checks (J/K/L/M/N) route through one shared orphan_report() helper controlled by one variable, so the Phase 5->6 promotion is a single default-value flip rather than five separate info->fail edits.

CI wiring: no existing CI/precommit/hooksPath mechanism found anywhere in the repo; added a minimal tracked .github/workflows/check-extension-docs.yml rather than a local git-hooks-based solution (core.hooksPath would require a local git-config change, out of scope per the git safety protocol).

Restored one context/index.json entry (project/neovim/domain/extension-deploy-modes.md) that install-extension.sh's merge_index_entries step transiently dropped as an unrelated side effect of the Phase 1 symlink recreation (root cause not fully isolated; a faithful sandbox replica did not reproduce it) -- verified via full before/after path diff and manually restored byte-for-byte from git history.
